'''The White Ship''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Movement''':  If you are in [[Arkham]] or an [[Other World]], you may move to the first area of any Other World instead of your normal [[movement]].  You may do this even if there are no open [[gate]]s leading to that Other World.

==Mythos Source==
The White Ship is featured in the short story of the same name.  ''The White Ship'' was written by H.P. Lovecraft in November of 1919.  The story detailed the travels of a lighthouse keeper, [[Basil Elton]], who befriended the captain of the white ship and travelled through the Dreamlands.
